name: luxury-mango-shake-splash
image_vibe: Glossy commercial luxury, mango-gold freshness, high-speed dynamic splash
image_purpose: Create a premium product campaign visual for a mango shake bottle.

prompt.project_info: High-speed commercial luxury shake photography featuring a centered hero bottle.
prompt.main_subject: An elegant frosted glass bottle filled with velvety mango shake, branded MANGO AURÉLIA with a minimalist vertical ivory label and embossed brushed-gold serif typography. The liquid is creamy golden mango with rich natural pulp swirls.
prompt.composition_elements: Centered hero bottle with crisp reflection on polished ivory marble, sculptural waves of thick mango shake exploding outward, silky puree ribbons suspended mid-air, floating fresh mango cubes, mango slices, and fine creamy golden mist droplets.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Luxury glossy studio product lighting, sharp rim light defining the bottle silhouette, brilliant highlights on splashes and mango surfaces, and a soft warm golden background glow.
prompt.technical_specs: Macro lens at eye level, ultra-fast shutter freezing motion, shallow depth of field focused on the label, gentle blur on splash elements, 8K-style ultra-photorealistic texture.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a high-speed commercial luxury product photograph of an elegant frosted glass bottle filled with velvety creamy golden mango shake with rich natural pulp swirls. The centered bottle carries a minimalist vertical ivory label reading MANGO AURÉLIA in embossed brushed-gold serif typography. Surround it with sculptural waves of thick mango shake, silky puree ribbons suspended mid-air, floating fresh mango cubes, glossy mango slices, and fine droplets of creamy golden mist. Place the bottle with a crisp reflection on polished ivory marble. Use macro eye-level photography, ultra-fast freeze-motion capture, sharp rim lighting, brilliant highlights, shallow focus on the label, warm golden glow, and a background gradient from mango gold to champagne cream.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, malformed bottle, unreadable intended label, misspelled brand text, extra bottles, distorted liquid, plastic CGI look, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra objects, deformed

assets.name: MANGO AURÉLIA hero bottle concept
assets.usage: Use only for bottle silhouette, frosted glass, label layout, mango liquid, and splash composition; do not introduce unrelated branding.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Preserve the MANGO AURÉLIA label, ivory-and-gold luxury palette, centered bottle, polished marble, mango splash, macro lens, and freeze-motion technique. The bottle shape and splash arrangement may vary while keeping the label legible and consistent.
